summary: Confirms shared 5-hour rolling and 7-day weekly quota pool across Claude web, Desktop, Cowork, and Claude Code; warns that setting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY routes Claude Code to pay-as-you-go Console billing.
Confirms monthly API credit grants on Max and Team plans apply strictly to Console API/SDK workloads and do not extend interactive chat/Claude Code session limits.
Specifies that prompt caches are isolated per model ID; mid-session model switches invalidate the prefix cache, whereas effort parameter adjustments on Claude 5.5 preserve the cache.
Documents Haiku 4.5 removal from consumer chat/Cowork model selectors on 29 Oct 2026 with automatic migration to Haiku 5.5.
Documents root-down AGENTS.override.md > AGENTS.md discovery hierarchy and 32 KiB project_doc_max_bytes cap in OpenAI Codex.
Documents retirement of approval_policy='untrusted' in favour of project trust_level='untrusted' and approval_policy='on-request', plus web_search='cached' isolation.
Documents 19 Oct 2026 deprecation of .agents/workflows/*.md in Google Antigravity and migration via /migrate-workflows to .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

Verified T05 revision leak prevention and P1-10 tombstone payload erasure across SYS-0002 / SERVICE-BRAVO (1.00 at 2026-05-15 vs 1.50 at 2026-09-01) and SYS-0001 / NODE-ALPHA (0.12 at 2026-06-01 vs 0.08 at 2026-09-01).
